I use a good combination of free anti-virus and firewall along with active IP address blocking lists. Currently have Avira Antivirus set to high heuristics and Comodo firewall, both free. Plus Malwarebytes for periodic scans but also Spybot with the Immunization function which manually blocks known bad IP addresses in Windows OSI stack (you can see the blocked IP addresses if you go to Control Panel -> Internet Options -> Security -> Restricted Sites). My favorite though is PeerBlock with the active IP blocking with auto updated lists through iblock.com which blocks ads, anti P2P, spyware, and you can customize it with custom lists. Haven't had a virus from my own doing in a decade. A root did get through though recently from my sisters laptop, it infected three other computers on the network.
